name: ai-safe-earth
description: Plugins from AI SAFE EARTH: audit the prompts and algorithms of AI-enabled software for profiling, manipulation, engineered emotional attachment, deceptive identity and behavioural influence over the person using it; review each finding with a named person, remediate one approval at a time, and evaluate the running system with fixed scenarios. Findings describe evidence and a policy decision, never a compliance verdict.

plugins.name: aisafe
plugins.description: The ai-safety-audit skill: audit the prompts and algorithms of AI-enabled software for profiling, manipulation, engineered emotional attachment, deceptive identity and behavioural influence over the person using it (aisafe audit), document the system before and after, record a named person's review (aisafe review), remediate one approval at a time, and evaluate the running system with fixed scenarios (aisafe evaluate). Deterministic and offline; never a compliance verdict.
